Chapter 424: Chapter 3: Meeting the Galaxy Master (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

You should know, this is not about traversing worlds, it is the Main World.

In the traversing worlds, Lin Yuan had an abundance of time, but lacked many of the conveniences of the Main World.

For instance, the continuously fluctuating Origin Source of the Battlefields of Different Races could provide Lin Yuan great benefits in comprehending the Space Core Model.

There was also that segment of a body from a Supreme Being of the Magic Jade Tower within the Virtual World.

Of course, the traversing worlds also have their advantages, each with its own strengths and weaknesses.

...

…

Inner World.

It was vast and boundless, almost thirty thousand miles in circumference.

When he had newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, Lin Yuan’s Inner World had swelled to a circumference of twenty-five thousand miles.

But through cultivation and the continual enhancement of his understanding of Space Rules, the expansion speed of the world had increased noticeably.

Now, it had even reached twenty-eight thousand miles.

In the southeast corner of the Inner World.

Hongpi and Bieyan, the two Eighth Rank Alien Race members, had a numb look in their eyes.

Ever since they were brought here by Lin Yuan, the shock in their hearts had never ceased.

Wasn’t it said that Peak Master Shisan had just entered the Eighth Rank?

Could someone who had just entered the Eighth Rank possess such a vast Inner World?

After exchanging a glance, Hongpi and Bieyan only felt their mouths becoming parched.

Normally, the Inner World of someone who had just entered the Eighth Rank would only have a circumference of a hundred miles.

Subsequently, as one cultivated further and deepened their understanding of Space Rules, the Inner World would gradually expand.

But as for Lin Yuan…

Hongpi and Bieyan, the two Eighth Rank members of the Alien Race, swallowed hard. Both in middle and later stages of the Eighth Rank together did not have an Inner World one-third as large as that of Lin Yuan, who was in the early stages of the Eighth Rank.

It was simply inconceivable.

“I finally understand why the Star Lord told us to follow the Peak Master and said what he did at the time.”

Hongpi was silent for a while before speaking dryly.

The words Chikun Star Lord had spoken roughly meant that they should simply follow Lin Yuan’s commands.

As for protecting Lin Yuan… not a word was mentioned.

At that time, Hongpi and Bieyan were somewhat puzzled. If Lin Yuan, as someone who had just entered the Eighth Rank, was going to sit in the Fringe Starfield, wasn’t their mission to ensure his safety?

Now it seems that Peak Master Shisan, who had just entered the Eighth Rank, did not need their protection at all.

Based on the range of the Inner World, Lin Yuan’s strength was more than enough to easily crush both of them.

The two Eighth Rank Alien Race beings pondered deeply. Their mission in following Lin Yuan was probably to handle the trifles, so that Lin Yuan would not waste his precious time on those matters.

“Abnormal, too abnormal.”

“How could human civilization have such an abnormality.”

Hongpi couldn’t help but say, a person who matched the Eighth Rank peak just after entering the Eighth Rank was a rarity even among those special life forms.

“Perhaps, this is why human civilization has become a Peak Clan?”

Bieyan murmured to himself in a low voice.

The history of human civilization is not very long, only a little over two million years. But within such a short time, human civilization leapt to become a Peak Clan dominating the starry skies, because they gave birth to one genius after another.

Here, ‘genius’ does not simply refer to those talented in evolutionary paths but includes geniuses in all other areas as well.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, five years went by.

In the Milky Way Star Region, a black cosmic warship emerged from the wormholes.

“Master, we have arrived at the Milky Way Star Region,” said a sweet voice that belonged to the main control intelligence of the Silver Galaxy.

Inside the warship, Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes, hearing the sweet voice of the Silver Galaxy’s main control intelligence.

“At last, we’ve arrived….”

Lin Yuan looked through the spaceship, gazing at the outer starry sky.

He saw a star domain that resembled a silvery river ‘hanging’ in the starry sky, incredibly dazzling and beautiful.

“Five years…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was somewhat reflective; these five years had allowed him to make tremendous strides in various aspects.

Firstly, in the aspect of comprehending the core space model, Lin Yuan had now penetrated the two thousand and ninety-second kind.

One should know that there are a total of seven thousand seven hundred and eighty-two types of core space models. Having comprehended two thousand types equates to having completed a quarter of the journey.

Even Chikun Star Lord had not fully penetrated all core space models.

Once all the core space models were understood, it would be equivalent to mastering the Complete Space Rules, and the vast universe would be his to traverse.

Secondly, the opening of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s Eighth Layer Part was significant. If the opening of the Eighth Layer Part is divided into ten stages,

then Lin Yuan was close to completing the second stage. Bear in mind, any Evolution Path’s Eighth Layer Part is crucial for becoming a grand evolver in evolution studies.

The Eighth Layer Part of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was even more difficult. Merely five years and he had reached the second stage—those grand evolvers would likely become despondent if they heard this.

“`

Even for an evolutionary scholar, starting from scratch to establish an Eighth Rank Evolution Path is no easy task. It requires a significant amount of time and energy, and even then, one may not necessarily gain the approval of the three goddesses.

“I’ve already conceived over eleven thousand Evolution Paths. Why am I still just an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

In the five years since, Lin Yuan, at intervals, would comprehend that segment of his body. After advancing to the Eighth Rank, his realm had significantly improved. Even though he still had to withstand the Psychic Will Pressure, his comprehension speed had definitely increased greatly.

In just five short years, Lin Yuan had conceived more than seven thousand additional Evolution Paths. This was considering he only devoted part of his time to the task.

Otherwise, it would have been even more.

“No matter,”

“Just continue comprehending.”

“Whether you’re an ordinary member or a core one, what’s crucial is enhancing one’s own strength.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, continuously conceiving new Evolution Paths, then dissecting them to extract their essence, which was his main goal.

…

“World-Breaking Origin Force… I’ve accumulated fifteen strands already…”

Lin Yuan felt the “World-Breaking Origin Force” inside the majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms deep within his mind, a smile appearing on his face.

For Lin Yuan, the more World-Breaking Origin Force, the better, as it meant more opportunities for interdimensional travel.

It also represented an incredibly powerful life-saving ability.

Because—

Using fifty strands of World-Breaking Origin Force allowed for physical body transference.

On the surface, physical body transference meant his physical body could descend and travel between worlds.

Such a method of transference had its advantages and disadvantages.

The disadvantage was that if one died while traversing worlds, it could mean actual death.

The advantage, however, was that all enhancements in the traversed worlds could be synchronized with the physical body.

Plus, when evading assassination from the Main World, one could use physical body transference for evasion.

The worlds selected for transference by the Door to the Myriad Realms were not in the same dimension or plane as the Main World.

Once Lin Yuan comfortably hid within, even a Supreme Being would be left helpless and merely watch.

…

“Let’s go.”

“Directly to the main star.”

Lin Yuan commanded the “Silver Galaxy”.

Whoosh.

The Silver Galaxy once again turned into a bolt of black lightning, vanishing into the starry sky.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

This was a high-class life planet.

Since Lin Yuan was appointed as the Galaxy Master and designated this planet as the main star of the Milky Way Star Region.

Human officials from nearby star domains had arrived early to carry out a Class B transformation on this life planet.

Furthermore, a large army of human evolvers was stationed here. This evolver army, left behind after human civilization took over the star domain, acted as the new Star Lord’s left and right hands.

“The Star Lord should be arriving soon. Everyone, be at your best,” a man in an exquisite purple robe spoke in the skies above the Milky Way Main Star.

Next to him stood a blond man, and behind them a dense army of evolvers.

The evolver army was mainly composed of Fifth Rank Evolvers, governed by hundreds of Sixth Rank Evolvers, with the purple-robed man and the blond man, both Seventh Rank Evolvers, acting as leaders.

“Our Star Lord is really wealthy, directly going for a Class B transformation of the main star…” the blond man whispered.

Usually, newly advanced Eighth Rank Evolvers are quite poor. When they go to a star domain to become a Star Lord, they opt for the free Class C transformation.

A Class B transformation requires a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, roughly equivalent to the entire assets of a senior Eighth Rank Evolver, including their weapons and treasures.

“The Star Lord is an unrivaled genius. He stepped into the Eighth Rank at the age of a hundred, and his teacher is the Chikun Star Lord. Just the gifts received at his Eighth Rank celebration probably exceeded a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, incomparable to an ordinary Eighth Rank Star Lord,” said the purple-robed man, glancing at the blond man.

“Indeed…” the blond man nodded, his expression showing admiration.

He had been shocked for a long time when he first heard that the Milky Way Star Lord was the Shisan Peak Master of the Chikun Star Domain, a peerless prodigy of human civilization.

“Alright.”

“The Star Lord is here.”

The purple-robed man seemed to sense something.

His expression shifted slightly as he looked ahead.

Space began to subtly undulate, and a sleek, black cosmic battleship appeared quietly.

“Greetings, Galaxy Master.”

The purple-robed man and the blond man bowed together.

“Greetings, Galaxy Master!”

Behind them, a large army of evolvers knelt in unison, respectfully chanting: “Greetings, Galaxy Master.”
